page.overview:
Who is Bankuro?

Bankuro is a member of the former Roger Pirates.

Bankuro is a short, slender man with puffy, dark-colored hair and a beard. He has a pointed nose. He wears a dark-colored, short-sleeved shirt, a dark-colored hat with two horns sticking out of it, and baggy, light-colored pants.

In the anime, Bankuro's hair is white. However, in episode 966, when he is shown from behind, he has brown hair, and his hat with horns are also part of his hairstyle.

Bankuro laughed when he saw the treasure left behind by Joy Boy at the last island on the Grand Line. He smiled when Roger expressed his gratitude for his subordinates.
